Looping in a couple of operational notes from the sec ops side. If we confirm Thu 19 Jun 16:00 PDT, heres what I suggest so the meeting is efficient:

- Split option: 60 min technical walkthrough + optional 30 min vendor readout. Vendors often prefer a shorter scoping call; offers flexibility if youre running a pen with a 3rd party.
- Evidence transfer: preferred is SFTP with short-lived credentials OR secure SharePoint link; avoid unscoped Drive links. If Finova can upload an "evidence map" spreadsheet well pre-map required artifacts.
- Bridge: we use a Zoom bridge for internal demos (Ill include the link in the calendar invite).
- Required Redwood attendees: sec ops engineer (me), account lead (Marissa), and a solutions engineer if there are deep architecture questions.

If Lucy confirms the slot, Ill prepare a concise tech runbook and a short pre-call checklist so the meeting can focus on decisioning rather than triage.

Thanks,
